tasks.title: Calibrate Reactor
tasks.description: Go to the main utility closet and align the power fluctuations on the control panel.
tasks.hint: Check near the breaker box by the back door.

tasks.title: Download Data
tasks.description: Connect to the terminal in the study room and wait for the upload progress bar to finish.
tasks.hint: Look for the laptop setup on the main desk.

tasks.title: Fix Wiring
tasks.description: Match the colored wires correctly in the hallway junction box.
tasks.hint: Red to red, blue to blue—don't cross them up!

tasks.title: Water the Plants
tasks.description: Find the watering can in the kitchen and give the living room ferns a drink.
tasks.hint: The green plants by the window are looking thirsty.

tasks.title: Clear Asteroids
tasks.description: Scan the backyard or patio area and tap the targets displayed on your mobile screen.
tasks.hint: Head outside and look toward the garden fence.

sabotages.title: Reactor Meltdown
sabotages.description: The reactor is overheating! Fix it before time runs out.

sabotages.title: Oxygen Depletion
sabotages.description: The ship has lost oxygen! Restore it before everyone suffocates.

sabotages.title: Power Outage
sabotages.description: Power down! Fix it before the systems become unstable.
